title: Stabilize Home active-work tiles
summary: Stabilized Home active-work tiles by routing fast stdout-tail refresh and full refresh through a shared live-work renderer before the async launch-preflight refresh point.
reason: During CSV rerun work, the Home Pipeline and Current Item tiles could briefly fall back to idle snapshot/count values while Run Progress still had active CSV rerun evidence.
behavior_before: Full refresh could render snapshot-derived Home tiles such as Idle and 0 / 0, then await launch preflight before applying CSV rerun/live-work evidence.
behavior_after: Fast and full refresh both apply the same live-work Home summary before launch preflight can yield, keeping the Pipeline and Current Item tiles aligned with active CSV rerun evidence.
tests_added: Focused static guard that verifies Home live-work summary rendering runs in both fast-tail and full-refresh paths before launch preflight awaits.
Browser-backed Home live-state assertion that an idle/0-of-0 snapshot is overridden by active CSV rerun close-readiness/stdout evidence.
rollback_plan: Revert the app.js live-work renderer/order change and the matching focused test additions; no backend state, media policy, route, or filesystem mutation behavior changed.
notes:
Keep Home active-work tiles and live-run progress rendering in one shared path before async preflight refresh.
Add focused static coverage for CSV rerun evidence and Home live-work refresh ordering.
Assert Home Pipeline and Current Item tiles stay on active CSV rerun evidence instead of idle/0-of-0 fallback.
Refresh generated summary for touched WebView app asset.
Refresh generated summary for touched static test.
Refresh generated summary for touched browser smoke.
